key_findings.experimental_agreement: The HPD-RVE+CPFEM simulations under both uniaxial tension and compression for DP steel, as well as uniaxial tension for pure copper, produce stress-strain responses in quantitative agreement with independent experimental measurements (Tasan et al. 2014 for DP800; Bronkhorst et al. 1992 for OFHC Cu), confirming that the generated RVE models produce physically realistic responses across different materials and loading modes.
